Hi Sam — thanks for the heads-up and the summary. We can support both asks, but need to align on the accounting treatment and approvals internally before issuing anything. Quick notes:

- We typically issue a credit memo when the customer already received an invoice and needs a formal offset. For proactive trial/top-up grants we generally process a promo allowance that is documented with an internal promo approval and then recorded against a contra-revenue allowance (not a straight invoice offset).
- If ZenWave needs to reconcile against an incoming PO immediately, we can also provide a one-line invoice with a credit memo to net to zero — finance prefers this if the customer requires a PO reference.

Karthik/Priyom — can you please confirm whether we should: (A) create a promo allowance (journal to GL 6580 contra-revenue) and a separate internal memo, or (B) issue an invoice + immediate credit memo for the amount so ZenWave can post it against their PO? If we go with A, finance will need the signed approval form and the HubSpot approval record. If B, ops will need the billing contact for the PO and the invoice-to email.

Sam — attaching our promo approval template to expedite signatures. If you can return the signed form today, we can attempt same-day processing.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

- Tax: no VAT/tax liability for this promotional top-up as it's a contra entry (verify if customer jurisdiction requires reporting — Sam, confirm ZenWave's billing jurisdiction).
- Approvals: internal approval required from Sales Director (Karthik) and Customer Finance (Grace). Priyom, please attach the signed promo_approval_workflow.xlsx and the returned zenwave_promo_request_form.pdf to the HubSpot record and mark the workflow 'Promo Issued'.
- Ops: billing will create a one-line invoice for $12,000 with a matching credit memo and include PO reference field — target completion today EOD.

Priyom — once billing confirms creation, please loop Sam and attach the invoice/credit memo PDFs. I'll flag the accounting entries with AR so they don't auto-apply any cash receipts.
